_que_es: Critters de Steal & Fuse Critters (games/prueba), 2026-11-03. Referencia de estilo: la hoja de mascotas (assets/ui/pet-icons).

ia.prompt: Nine cute chunky baby creatures with big shiny eyes and happy faces, each standing on tiny stubby feet, in this order: 1) pebble_pup: a small grey puppy made of smooth round pebbles, 2) mossling: a round green moss blob creature with a little leaf sprout on its head, 3) bubblebug: a blue ladybug floating inside a shiny soap bubble, 4) zapfrog: a yellow frog with tiny lightning bolt marks on its back, 5) cloud_kitty: a white fluffy kitten shaped like a soft cloud, 6) lava_lizard: an orange-red lizard with glowing lava cracks on its skin, 7) star_owl: a purple owl with golden star patterns and starry eyes, 8) crystal_dragon: a small cyan dragon made of shiny crystal with little wings, 9) critter_egg: a big round spotted egg with colorful paw prints and no face.
